definitions.explanation: The wheel used to steer a car or other motor vehicle.
The bar used to steer a bicycle or motorcycle.
A part of an object designed to be held or operated by hand.

examples.japanese: ハンドルを{右|みぎ}に{切|き}った。
examples.english: I turned the steering wheel to the right.

examples.japanese: {自転車|じてんしゃ}のハンドルを{握|にぎ}る。
{運転中|うんてんちゅう}はハンドルから{手|て}を{離|はな}さないでください。
examples.english: Please don't take your hands off the steering wheel while driving.

notes:
ハンドル is a loanword from English "handle."

DRIVING EXPRESSIONS:
- ハンドルを{切|き}る (to turn the steering wheel)
- ハンドルを{握|にぎ}る (to grip the steering wheel)
- ハンドルを{回|まわ}す (to turn the steering wheel)
- ハンドルを{離|はな}す (to let go of the steering wheel)

RIGHT-HAND DRIVE:
In Japan, cars have {右|みぎ}ハンドル (right-hand drive), with the steering wheel on the right side.

OTHER MEANINGS:
- {扉|とびら}のハンドル (door handle)
- {窓|まど}のハンドル (window crank)
- ハンドルネーム (online handle/username)

RELATED CAR PARTS:
- アクセル (accelerator)
- ブレーキ (brake)
- タイヤ (tire)
